scope: offline boundary checks; not model evaluation or project audit

stages.contract: Keep native text, page identity, raster occurrences, headers and honest quality; missing OCR is not a missing project fact.
stages.known_limit: Real OCR accuracy and canonical-clause attachment of page-level raster supplements are not certified by synthetic image tests.

stages.contract: Find explicitly scoped sections and all accessible prepared pages without using expected quantities to select evidence.
stages.known_limit: Passing regression searches does not measure recall on independently annotated documents.

stages.contract: Separate registered, fully exposed, partial and omitted evidence; retain exact identity, offsets and transport outcome under the existing budget.
stages.known_limit: Exposure in a completed context does not prove comprehension. Legacy traces without receipt/fingerprint metadata remain unmeasured.

stages.contract: The model must identify property, subject, scope and required relation without demanding unrelated evidence.
stages.known_limit: Protocol fixtures are not model answers or evidence of factual effectiveness.

stages.contract: A fact retains literal provenance, units, quality, subject scope and immutable dependencies; another row's verdict cannot replace evidence.
stages.known_limit: The existing shared fact ledger primarily covers geometry. Generic semantic relations for arbitrary material properties are not established.

stages.contract: Reject altered quotes, unknown units, unverified scope and contradictions while preserving independently proven assertions.
stages.known_limit: General properties are checked separately from retained domain-specific adapters; passing these tests does not certify those adapters on new standards.

stages.contract: Absence of proof is needs_facts; a discrepancy needs incompatible scoped evidence; geometry alone cannot confirm an entire row.
stages.known_limit: No database publication or production project status is changed by this suite.

stages.contract: Route by fact kind and source responsibility; read registered but unexposed evidence before repeating search; retry only on changed evidence, without confirming anything.
stages.known_limit: No follow-up model pass is dispatched by the suite.

development_data.role: development regressions; not an independent benchmark
development_data.synthetic_contracts: also development data, not a blind holdout
